about: The saint commemorated at the reception of the heavenly gifts is also the one whose prayers are sought for our protection.

s01.translation: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, we humbly beseech You, our God: may we also be protected by the prayers of the saint we commemorated when we received these gifts. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

alignments.gloss: in whose commemoration we received these gifts,
by his prayers we may also be protected
who lives and reigns with You

w001.explanation: We have received the heavenly food and drink before making the request.

w007.explanation: “You” names God, to whom the prayer for protection is made.

w012.explanation: The saint commemorated when we received these gifts is the same saint whose prayers are sought for our protection.

w013.explanation: “These” points to the Eucharistic gifts already received by the praying community.

w016.explanation: “His” points back to the saint identified by “whose.” The prayer seeks protection for us through that saint’s prayers.

w036.explanation: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
